svg.title: Storage bed - general arrangement
svg.text: mattress 1400 x 2000 - overall 1490 x 2150 x 960 - all dimensions in mm
height, headboard 960 at the centre of the arch
top of slats 400 above the floor
side rail 160 x 32, 2090 over the tenons
side rail to post 20 mm tenon, 45 deep,
drawn up by 2 bed bolts per joint
end rails to post 20 mm tenon, 32 deep, glued
panels 18 thick, floating in 10 mm grooves
The bed knocks down: undo eight bolts and the two ends,
two rails and the deck come apart.
